design.output_budget_repair: V3 changed only max_tokens from 2048 to 8192 after V2 exposed MaxRounds truncation; the evidence prompt and semantic contract were unchanged.

cross_panel_context.interpretation: All three models preserved the core reusable verification, tool-recovery, and completion primitives on every V3 draw while producing byte-distinct free-form states. Qwen and DeepSeek nevertheless selected an explicitly instance-binding primitive in 5/6 draws despite the instruction not to generalize the instance-only fact. This motivates a serialization/abstraction-boundary diagnostic, not a general model-quality ranking.

harness_lessons.v1: Local config parse failure occurred before provider dispatch; zero usage rows and zero model requests.
harness_lessons.v2: A 2048 completion budget confounded reasoning-heavy Qwen/DeepSeek with MaxRounds truncation; V2 remains harness-development evidence only.
harness_lessons.atomcode_no_tools_boundary: No V3 tool.start events were observed. Elsewhere AtomCode 5.0.9 can expose schedule_wakeup even under --no-tools, so future panels must continue auditing full JSONL and VOID any tool event or multi-usage invocation.
